An '''ablative heatshield''' was designed to allow an individual to survive re-entry into a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Farstine)|bounty hunter]] used an ablative heatshield and a [[Parachute/Legends|parachute]] to jump from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] to the surface of the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to rescue a [[Unidentified child (Dantooine)|child]].<ref name="TRG1-" /> [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] also employed ablative heatshields to perform orbital drops,<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> and larger shields were mounted on [[Warlord Dropship]]s to enable the craft to survive high speed atmospheric re-entry.<ref name="WC" /> Ablative sheathes were fitted on the noses of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] before the [[Second Battle of Borleias]] in order to make them look like [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorites]] burning up on entry into [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias's]] atmosphere.<ref name="Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> Members of [[Wraith Squadron]] and the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] utilized [[individual atmospheric intrusion pod]]s mounted with ablative heatshields during their infiltration of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] via [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] insertion during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="EL1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>
